# Session Git
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that draws your forked sessions as a branch tree and merges a branch's fin
ished work back into the main session as a digest, so you don't have to retype what the branch found
shed work back into the main session as a digest, so you don't have to retype what the branch found.
Forking a session to explore is easy in Harness, but the main session can't see what happened in the
fork: its conclusions, the files it changed, the commands it ran, the decisions you made there. Ses
sion Git brings that back.
## Features
- **Branch map**: the "Session Git" tab in the right sidebar shows the tree around the current sessi
on: where each branch forked, how many turns it has of its own, and how far it has been merged. The

"Session Git" panel in the left sidebar lists every forked tree in the workspace.
- **One-click merg
e**: in the main session, click "Merge here" on a branch; inside a branch, click "Merge into parent"

. Or type `/merge`.
- **Incremental merges**: merging the same branch again brings only what is new

since the last merge. Add `--all` to start over from the fork point.
- **Silent by default**: the di
gest is queued and reaches the agent with your next message, without interrupting the conversation.
A strip above the composer says the merge is queued. Add `--wake`, or write a note after `--`, to ha

ve the agent act right away.
- **Unmerged reminders**: when you come back to the main session and a
branch has new work that isn't merged yet, the strip above the composer offers "Merge here" or "Igno

re". It comes back once the branch completes another turn.
- **The agent can use it too**: the runti
me context tells the agent which branches exist. When you say "bring in what the branch found", it c
an call `session_branches` and then `session_branch_merge`. What the agent reads this way counts as
sion_branches` and then `session_branch_merge`. What the agent reads this way counts as a merge too.

## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or later.
In DeepSeek Harness, open Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin, and enter the GitHub

Installing from GitHub needs this machine to reach GitHub. You can also download the repository and
enter the absolute path of the plugin folder in the same dialog.
From the command line:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart Harness when it asks you to.
## Usage
### In the UI
1. Click "Branch into a new conversation" under a reply, or choose "Fork session" from the session's

menu in the sidebar, and explore in the fork.
2. When you're done, open "Session Git" in the fork's
right sidebar and click "Merge into parent". Or go back to the main session and click "Merge here"

in the strip above the composer.
3. Send your next message in the main session as usual. The agent a
nswers with the branch's digest in view.
Sidebar options:

- "Summary", "Full" and "Conclusion only" set how detailed the digest is.
- "Let the agent act right
away" is the same as `--wake`.
### Commands
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Form | Meaning |
| `/merge` | With one branch, merges it. With several, merges the only one with new work, or lists t
hem for you to pick. Inside a branch that has no branches of its own, merges it into its parent. Typ

ing `/merge` alone in the composer opens a branch picker. |
| `/merge #2` | Picks a branch by its nu

mber on the map. A title (partial match) or the first 4+ characters of a session id also work. |
| `

summary` / `full` / `last` | How detailed the digest is; `summary` is the default. |
| `turns:3` | O

nly the most recent 3 turns, in full detail. |
| `--all` | Ignore earlier merges and start over from

the fork point. |
| `--wake` | Wake the agent right after merging. |
| `--up` | Merge the current b

ranch into its parent. |
[该节后续省略]
### What a digest contains
A digest is background material for the agent. Its sections, with step detail compressed first when
it runs over the size limit:

1. How the branch relates to this session: where it forked and which turns this merge covers.
2. The

branch's goal, if one was set.
3. Each turn: your message, the gist of the agent's reply, the tools

it used, and work delegated to subagents.
4. Decisions you made in the branch, such as answers to t

he agent's questions.
5. Files changed and commands run.
6. The to-do list and compaction summaries.
7. The branch's final conclusion.
The digest opens by telling the agent that plans and to-dos from the branch are only a record and ne
ed your go-ahead, and that when both sessions share a working directory, the branch's file changes a
re already on disk and the actual files win.
## Known limitations
- A queued merge behaves like a queued message: if you press Stop, or restart Harness, before the ag
ent reads it, Harness cancels it. The strip above the composer then shows the branch as not merged a

gain; merge once more and nothing is lost.
- Silent merges don't appear in the conversation itself,
because Harness doesn't render plain context injections. Their state shows in the strip above the co

mposer and on the branch map.
- Subagent sessions are left off the map; branches under them hang off

the nearest visible session.
- Merging reads the session records on this machine. The plugin makes
no network requests and sends your sessions nowhere.
